title: fix: allow probe output after reasoning
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises the short text-probe output cap from 10 to 64 tokens
- Prevents reasoning tokens from consuming the entire allowance and producing false empty-response failures
- Keeps one request per model and all existing timeouts unchanged

Checks:
- Biome
- `node --check operations/community-monitor/probe.mjs`
- Controlled production probe: capped model returned valid text with 41 completion tokens at the new limit

gist.headline: Room for the answer
gist.blurb: The community monitor now leaves enough space for models to finish a sentence after doing their internal thinking. Tiny token budget, fewer imaginary empty replies.
gist.summary: Raised the community-monitor short probe output cap from 10 to 64 tokens so reasoning tokens no longer consume the full allowance and trigger false empty-response failures.
gist.impact: Model probes can now return valid completion text after reasoning while keeping the existing one-request-per-model behavior and timeouts.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy monitoring garden where Polli checks a retro terminal's small response jar, now enlarged enough for a thoughtful model response to emerge after a swirl of tiny reasoning pixels. The scene represents a probe receiving a real answer rather than mistaking an exhausted token budget for silence.
